content: {"summary":"Login 503 errors rose slowly in April 2025 because auth-service’s TLS connections to auth-db-01 failed with an expired server certificate; PostgreSQL had not reloaded the renewed certificate, so it kept presenting the old expired cert until a manual reload cleared the issue.","likely_cause":"PostgreSQL on auth-db-01 continued to present an expired TLS certificate after renewal because the server process did not reload the new certificate, causing auth-service connection failures and a gradual increase in 503 responses.","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Auth-service returned 503 errors that crept up over time","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#0"],"quote":"`/v1/auth/login` is returning `503`, and the rate has been creeping up since roughly the top of the hour rather than jumping."},{"text":"Auth-service pods logged failed dials with x509 expiration","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#0"],"quote":"logs failed dials to auth-db-01 with `x509: certificate has expired`"},{"text":"Server presented a different, expired certificate serial than the renewed file","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#2"],"quote":"server hands out carries a different serial from that file"},{"text":"PostgreSQL kept the previous certificate in memory and did not reload it","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#2"],"quote":"Postgres has kept the previous certificate in memory, and nothing has reloaded it"},{"text":"Connection pool retirement caused the slow climb of 503s","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#2"],"quote":"Our pool retires a connection after an hour, or after half an hour idle"},{"text":"Reloading PostgreSQL configuration restored new connections and stopped 503s","evidence_ids":["INC-0031#2"],"quote":"new connections succeed, the `503`s have stopped"}],"next_checks":["Verify that certificate renewal jobs trigger a pg_reload_conf on auth-db instances automatically","Add monitoring to alert on the serial number of the certificate actually presented by auth-db versus the file on disk","Confirm that auth-service continues to use sslmode=verify-full after any certificate change","Check that connection pool settings allow graceful handling of temporary TLS failures"]}
